systemd:
[Unit]
Description=T3 Code server
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=%h
Environment=T3CODE_HOME="/home/test/T3 Code%%name"
Environment=T3CODE_INSTALL_BIN_DIR=/home/test/.local/bin
Environment=T3_BOOT_SERVICE_UNIT=t3code.service
ExecStart="/home/test/T3 Code/runtime/versions/1.2.3/t3" __service-launcher
KillMode=mixed
OOMPolicy=continue
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
CPUWeight=1000
IOWeight=1000
MemoryLow=1536M
OOMScoreAdjust=100
ManagedOOMPreference=avoid
StandardOutput=append:/home/test/T3 Code/logs/boot-service.log
StandardError=append:/home/test/T3 Code/logs/boot-service.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

task:
<Task version="1.2" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <RegistrationInfo>
    <Description>T3 Code server</Description>
  </RegistrationInfo>
  <Triggers>
    <LogonTrigger>
      <UserId>DOMAIN\user&other</UserId>
    </LogonTrigger>
    <TimeTrigger>
      <StartBoundary>2000-01-01T00:00:00</StartBoundary>
      <Repetition>
        <Interval>PT1M</Interval>
      </Repetition>
    </TimeTrigger>
  </Triggers>
  <Principals>
    <Principal id="Author">
      <UserId>DOMAIN\user&other</UserId>
      <LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType>
      <RunLevel>LeastPrivilege</RunLevel>
    </Principal>
  </Principals>
  <Settings>
    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
    <StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries>
    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT0S</ExecutionTimeLimit>
    <Priority>5</Priority>
  </Settings>
  <Actions Context="Author">
    <Exec>
      <Command>C:\Windows\System32\conhost.exe</Command>
      <Arguments>--headless "C:\T3 Code\runtime\versions\1.2.3\t3.exe" "__service-launcher" "--base-dir" "C:\T3 & Code\\" "--log-file" "C:\T3 Code\logs\boot-service.log" "--service-unit" "t3code-task.xml"</Arguments>
      <WorkingDirectory>C:\Users\test</WorkingDirectory>
    </Exec>
  </Actions>
</Task>
